connectors.note: The S05 charges on DC (54.5 kW, 30–80% in 20 min per the Deepal brochure), so it has a CCS2 inlet as well as Type 2; PakNEV lists both. The row had Type 2 only.

consumption.note: PakNEV: 16.6 kWh/100 km in electric mode (estimate).
